note: Registers the real OrangeCount entry points that gates 3..5 must find. A registration is not evidence by itself: the gate re-reads each file, checks the recorded markers, the fixed seed, the recorded pipeline wiring when one is claimed, and any committed run record. Gate 3: tools/genprediff runs the pinned Beancount 3.2.3 oracle against generated ledgers and promotes differences to testdata/fixtures/gen; its markers, seed and promotion corpus are verified. Gate 4: reads docs/compatibility/inventory-gate4-run.json, a real offline run of the public-fixture prefix differential (accepted_roundtrips=36, checkpoints=74). Gate 5 was re-run on 2026-10-28 with the product-owner-authorised private ledger; docs/compatibility/inventory-gate5-run.json is that run record, and the capture is read-only with aggregate counts only.

generative_differential.description: Deterministic synthetic ledger generator with a fixed seed that evaluates every case with both the Go engine and the pinned Beancount 3.2.3 oracle and compares six dimensions: (1) validity, meaning the error-class set and its multiplicity; (2) ordered entries, compared in source order rather than as a sorted multiset; (3) the complete inventory after every single transaction, not only the final balances; (4) final balances including cost lots; (5) every price directive as date/base/quote/rate; (6) period income and expense totals per month and currency. Differences are promoted to paired .bean/.json regressions under testdata/fixtures/gen.
